title: Group Trip Payment
scenario: A new number in the trip group says the organiser changed the payment account.

answers.A: Pay the new account before the booking is cancelled.
answers.B: Confirm the change with the organiser using a known number.
answers.C: Check the booking or payment platform before sending money.
answers.D: Ask the new number to send the organiser full name and itinerary.

explanation: A changed payment account is a classic impersonation pattern. Verify out of band before changing where money goes.
proTip: A new bank detail needs a second channel, every time.
